title: Unlocking G4 DNA affinity through aromatic side chains: a comparative study of nickel(II), copper(II), and zinc(II) salnaphen derivatives.
authors: D'Anna, Luisa; Rozza, Riccardo; Froux, Aurane; Jandl, Christian; Rubino, Simona; Spinello, Angelo; La Rosa, Lorenza; Gentile, Carla; Magistrato, Alessandra; Terenzi, Alessio; Bonsignore, Riccardo; Barone, Giampaolo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金属配合物与G4 DNA的亲和力及分子动力学模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作外的核酸-小分子互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象非蛋白-DNA体系。
abstract: Three nickel(II), copper(II), and zinc(II) salnaphen complexes, bearing structurally related charged side chains, were designed to elucidate the role of substituent size and shape in determining their binding strength and affinity for G-quadruplex (G4) DNA structures. Solution DNA-binding studies revealed that aromatic complexes exhibited enhanced G4 stabilization compared to non-aromatic analogues, with copper(II) complexes displaying the strongest affinity and a marked sequence-dependent DNA-binding profile. Molecular dynamics simulations provide a structural rationale for these observations, revealing for the first time that aromatic substituents foster more persistent end-stacking interactions and enhanced stability of the metal complex-G4 system, bridging ligand design, G4 recognition, and biological response. Consistently, the most effective G4 stabilizer also exhibits measurable antiproliferative activity in vitro, associated with pronounced reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, highlighting how G4 targeting and redox-mediated cytotoxicity-two features only rarely addressed together-can be effectively combined within a single molecular framework.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了三种带有结构相关带电侧链的镍(II)、铜(II)和锌(II) salnaphen配合物，以阐明取代基大小和形状在决定其对G-四链体（G4）DNA结构的结合强度和亲和力中的作用。溶液中的DNA结合研究表明，与不含芳香基团的类似物相比，含芳香基团的配合物表现出增强的G4稳定性，其中铜(II)配合物显示出最强的亲和力，并具有显著的序列依赖性DNA结合特征。分子动力学模拟为这些观察结果提供了结构上的解释，首次揭示芳香取代基促进更持久的端部堆叠相互作用，并增强金属配合物-G4体系的稳定性，从而桥接配体设计、G4识别和生物响应。与此一致，最有效的G4稳定剂在体外也表现出可测量的抗增殖活性，并伴随显著的活性氧（ROS）生成，突显了G4靶向和氧化还原介导的细胞毒性——这两个很少被同时考虑的特征——如何能在单一分子框架内有效结合。
